question: Does the patio footprint currently have pavers, a fire pit, and a deck, or is it open lawn?
unblocks: the demolition task list and whether deck-post integration work applies

choices: Pavers + fire pit present, no deck (per proposal, minus the deck reference)
Open lawn, no pavers/fire pit/deck (per drawing renders)
A deck is also present and must be demoed

why_it_matters: Demolition scope and the 'integrate posts with existing deck framing' detail depend on which condition is real.

question: Does the Dec 26, 2026 start date need to shift to keep foundation/framing work outside the winter window?
unblocks: whether foundation and framing tasks can be sequenced starting Dec 26 or must be pushed past mid-Feb 2027

choices: Keep Dec 26 start; sequence foundation/framing after mid-Feb 2027
Push the overall start to after mid-Feb 2027
Request a documented exception for winter foundation/framing work

why_it_matters: Canon bars foundation and framing between mid-December and mid-February; the current start date sits inside that window.

question: Is the outdoor fireplace a framed chase with Class A metal pipe or a site-built masonry system?
unblocks: fireplace footing design and framing package before the concrete pour

choices: Framed chase with Class A double-wall pipe (per drawing note)

why_it_matters: The footing, chase framing, and flue procurement differ by system type and must lock before the slab pour.

question: Which slab footprint dimensions govern: the proposal's 12.5'x23.5' or the drawing's ~24'x12'/22'11"x11'8"?
unblocks: excavation, concrete, and roof framing quantity takeoffs

choices: Field measurement required to confirm before excavation

why_it_matters: Excavation, concrete volume, and roof-framing spans are sized off this footprint.

question: Are the window and door openings shown on the existing tie-in wall new cuts or existing-to-remain?
unblocks: whether wall-opening demo and framing is added to the task graph

choices: All existing-to-remain, no wall openings cut
Some or all are new openings requiring demo/framing

why_it_matters: Cutting new openings in the existing brick wall is structural demo/framing scope not itemized in the proposal.

question: What is the contracted knee-wall height and finish: 2' white vinyl, or 3'-4 1/4" painted beadboard interior?
unblocks: screen-wall framing height and inclusion/exclusion of an interior finish task

choices: 2' tall, white vinyl exterior only (per proposal)
3'-4 1/4" tall with painted beadboard interior (per drawing)

why_it_matters: Screen-wall framing height and whether an interior finish task exists both depend on this.

question: Will electrical (lights/fan/GFCI) be added to the porch scope, or does the customer sign a zero-electrical acknowledgement?
unblocks: whether an electrical task and permit are added before framing closes

choices: Zero-electrical written acknowledgement (per current proposal scope)

why_it_matters: Canon requires this resolved before roof sheathing and screen framing close.

question: What is the fireplace's finished width and wall position: 72" (proposal) or 76"/6'-4" per the drawing plan?
unblocks: footing width/location staking before footing excavation and rebar

choices: 72" wide, front edge 5'-5 1/8" from left (per proposal/plan)
Confirm width/location with customer before layout

why_it_matters: Footing width and front-edge post spacing must be staked before footing forms are set.

question: Does the screened enclosure include an operable window and a lockable glazed door, or is it screen-only per the proposal?
unblocks: whether a windows/doors procurement line is added to the framing package

choices: Screen-only enclosure with one $125 screen door (per proposal)
Include an operable window and lockable glazed door (per drawing renders)

why_it_matters: A window and keyed door add procurement and framing scope the contract total doesn't itemize.

question: Who pulls the building permit for the roof tie-in and fireplace: Tri-Cities or the customer?
unblocks: assigning the permit task owner before demo is scheduled

choices: Tri-Cities pulls the permit (per proposal's 'includes permitting' language)

why_it_matters: Demo cannot start until permit responsibility is confirmed in writing per policy.

question: Does the roof ledger/beam connection to the existing home require a stamped engineering design?
unblocks: whether an LVL/engineered beam is procured and when framing can be ordered

choices: No, standard framing member per IRC prescriptive sizing

why_it_matters: An engineered member changes procurement lead time and must be specified before the framing package is ordered.

question: Do the existing HVAC condenser and roofline gutter/downspout near the work area need protection, relocation, or new scope?
unblocks: adding any needed protection/relocation/gutter tasks to site-prep and roofing sequencing

choices: Protect in place, no relocation or added scope needed
Condenser needs temporary relocation during construction
New gutter/downspout scope needed at the tie-in

why_it_matters: Both sit immediately adjacent to the new roof tie-in and aren't addressed in the proposal.

question: Is the shed-roof carrying beam/header across the post line dimensional lumber or an LVL/engineered member?
why_it_matters: Decides whether an LVL order with its own lead time enters the plan ahead of framing.

question: Is the outdoor fireplace unit (firebox + Class A pipe or masonry kit) selected and ordered, and what lead time was quoted?

choices: Site-built masonry — no unit to order

why_it_matters: The fireplace footing is poured into the slab and sized to the final unit, so the slab cannot be formed until the unit is fixed and on order.

question: Do any existing vents (dryer, plumbing stack, range hood, bath fan, flue) exit the tie-in wall or roof area under the new shed roof?
unblocks: checklist item appliance_vent_extension (Extend existing appliance vents through new roof)
why_it_matters: Any vent landing under the new roof must be extended through it per code, adding a work package and roof penetrations to flash.

question: Is the roof and screen-wall framing done by the in-house crew or a framing sub?
unblocks: checklist item framing (Framing (floor, walls, roof structure, sheathing))
why_it_matters: Canon never splits framing, and subs run larger crews with shorter durations, so this sets crew size and days.

question: Are steps needed between the house doors and the patio slab, or from the slab down to the yard?

choices: No steps — slab meets doors and grade
Steps from house doors down to slab
Steps from slab down to yard

why_it_matters: A level change adds a step build and railing package the proposal does not describe.

question: Who builds the fireplace brick exterior, hearth, and mantel: a masonry sub, the in-house crew, or the fireplace vendor?
unblocks: checklist item siding (Siding (WRB, siding, tie-in blend))
why_it_matters: The chimney veneer runs alongside knee-wall vinyl and trim, and a sub trade changes crew, duration, and sequencing on the exterior block.

question: Does the scope include seed and straw (or sod) at the disturbed edges after the slab pour?

choices: Seed and straw at disturbed edges

why_it_matters: Landscaping is included only when seed and straw are in scope; the proposal names only minor hand grading.
